clauses.clause_label: Assignment or transfer of Customer rights
clauses.scope_note: Restricts transferring the license rights granted to Customer to a third party; prior written consent is required and may not be unreasonably withheld or delayed. This concerns the Software licensed under this Agreement, not unrelated artifacts.
clauses.condition_explanation: The transfer is prohibited unless Stream.io has given prior written consent.

clauses.clause_label: Compliance with law; export of technical data
clauses.scope_note: Customer must not violate applicable law, rules, or regulations, including those regarding export of technical data. The text does not specify additional license permissions for exporting or distributing the Software.
clauses.condition_explanation: Customer must comply with applicable law, including rules concerning export of technical data.

coverage_notes: The supplied numbered chunk covers lines 183–219 only. It contains no complete software license grant, so no permission is inferred from the contextual preamble.

Other numbered lines concern assignment by Stream.io, notices, governing law, venue, waiver, severability, interpretation, and entire-agreement terms; they do not state additional operative ASC terms.
